godot_forward: +Z in the file; the visual definition turns it 180 degrees to -Z
units_note: File units are not metres. The real CH-47 is about 30 m overall, so a visual definition would scale by about 0.096 to give about 30 m. No visual definition uses this model yet.
origin_note: Origin sits about 0.9 m (scaled) off the fuselage centre on X; wheels rest at y of about 0.9 file units.
collision_recommendation: Use simple BoxShape3D/CapsuleShape3D or custom RTS footprint data; do not use render mesh collision per unit.
source_pipeline: Sketchfab glTF-binary download (1k textures), imported unchanged; credit in godot/project/credits.json
